title: Quiet Zone
prompt: Create a context manager using @contextmanager named quiet that SUPPRESSES ValueError raised in its body but lets other exceptions propagate. The with-body must run.

tests.name: suppresses ValueError
tests.hint: Catch ValueError inside the generator after yield; do not re-raise.

tests.name: propagates others
tests.code:
try:
    with quiet():
        raise KeyError('boom')
    failed = False
except KeyError:
    failed = True
assert failed
tests.hint: Only ValueError is caught — everything else re-raises.
